items.title: LibLayaX
items.summary: Fast local AI decisions inside your application. A shared library and C API built on laya.cpp that runs the Laya typed-decision model in-process: no server, no Python. Windows, Linux and macOS, x64 and ARM64, CPU or GPU. An open-source alternative to Jev

items.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
items.title_cn: 机器人数据初创公司Mecka AI从红杉获得6000万美元$
items.summary: Mecka AI collects and analyzes human motion data to train humanoid robots and other kinds of robots. The startup pays people to record everyday tasks.
items.summary_cn: Mecka AI收集和分析人体运动数据，以训练人形机器人和其他类型的机器人。这家初创公司支付员工记录日常任务的费用。
items.comment: 基准测试成绩亮眼，但测试集和实际场景是两码事，别被数字忽悠。
